g.title: PSOMA
g.text: PSOMA — Particle Swarm Optimisation Memetic Algorithm

Continuous PSO over positions X ∈ [x_min, x_max]ⁿ, decoded by the Ranked-Order-Value rule into a giant tour and by Linear Split into routes; the global best is intensified by a simulated-annealing search whose neighbourhood operator (swap / insert / inverse) is chosen adaptively from EMA rewards. Objective: maximise profit = R·Σ waste − C·Σ distance.

g.title: cluster_sa
g.text: 3. SA search on the global best

g.title: a_params
g.text: Load capacity, R, C · sub-problem (all bins if vrpp)
PSOMAParams: pop_size 20, ω 1.0, c₁ 2.0, c₂ 2.0, max_iterations 200,

g.title: a_map
g.text: map local routes → global tour · km on full matrix

g.title: i_ops
g.text: SA operators = [swap, insert, inverse] on the giant tour

g.title: i_bias
g.text: biased distance matrix (μ = 10): pulls profitable nodes closer

g.title: m_swarm
g.text: X ~ U[x_min, x_max]ⁿ, V ~ U[v_min, v_max]ⁿ

g.title: m_train
g.text: TRAINING PHASE: for each operator op:

g.title: s_init
g.text: current = best = gbest (tour, X, mapping, profit, routes)

g.title: m_pso
g.text: PSO EXPLORATION — for each particle p:
V = ω·V + c₁·r₁⊙(pbest_X − X) + c₂·r₂⊙(gbest_X − X), clip to [v_min, v_max]

g.title: d_rov
g.text: ROV rule: mapping = argsort(X) · giant_tour = clients[mapping]

g.title: s_move
g.text: swap: exchange two positions · insert: move one node · inverse: reverse a segment
(X entries permuted consistently; Δdist is an O(1) surrogate on the biased matrix)

g.title: s_skip
g.text: reject early — skip the O(n²) split

g.title: d_split
g.text: LinearSplit.split(giant_tour): optimal cut of the sequence into
unprofitable non-mandatory nodes may be skipped (VRPP)
